title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: premium owed on a cover, by date
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line fixes the premium owed on a cover when the cover holder settles its premium balance, according to the date of settlement.

## Rule

1. On the cover's binding date, the premium owed is the premium the cover's product yields on the insured value the cover was bound for, because the premium charge booked that day applies the same build-up to the same records.
2. On any later date, the premium owed is the sum of the premium charges booked on the cover.
3. A cover that has never been bound, and so carries no binding date, owes no premium under this rule; its premium owed is 0.00.

## Condition table

| Cover | Date of settlement | Premium owed |
|---|---|---|
| Bound | The binding date | The premium the product yields on the insured value bound |
| Bound | Any later date | The sum of the premium charges booked on the cover |
| Never bound | any | 0.00 |

## Hypothetical cases

- **Case A (hypothetical figures):** a cover was bound three weeks ago and two premium charges of 400.00 and 35.50 USD appear on it. The premium owed is 435.50 USD.
- **Case B (hypothetical):** a cover is still in the quoted state and carries no binding date. Its premium owed is 0.00.
